title: Traps and monsters
summary: What stands in your way. Damage is out of the hero’s HP.

rows: Blocks the way. Some can be broken by Guillotine’s and Vesti’s skills.
Spikes stay up 1 s, down 1.8 s (0.15 s to switch).
Sweeps slowly across a row, announced by a warning sign.
Walks back and forth. Bump into one or step into its alert zone (1.5 or 2.5 tiles) and it starts chasing you.
Looks like a gold chest (appears 100% / 50% of the time where placed). Touch it and it chases you after 1 s.
Breathes ice along a row: 2 s wind-up, then 0.25 s of breath. Knocks you back.
Instant death, whatever your HP. Cross rivers on stepping stones and floating stones (1–3 tiles long).

sections.title: Moving hazards
sections.note: Launchers at the side of a row send these across again and again. Speed is in the table’s own units (higher is faster); the interval is the time between two launches.
